title: CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS referenced in coap/CMakeLists.txt but has no Kconfig symbol (coap_metrics.c unbuildable)
description: Two independent codereview passes on s8rl flagged: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/CMakeLists.txt:61 and :115 gate coap_metrics.c (which exists) on CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS, but no 'config LICHEN_COAP_METRICS' exists in any Kconfig file tree-wide. Dead gate: the metrics module can never be compiled. Either add the Kconfig block (model: siblings like LICHEN_COAP_STATUS, with depends on LICHEN_COAP_SERVER) or remove the dead CMake gates and coap_metrics.c. Note relationship to b7z9.29 (CCP-15 metrics layer spec-gap) -- if that work wants coap_metrics.c, the Kconfig symbol is a prerequisite.
close_reason: Fixed: added LICHEN_COAP_METRICS (bool, deps LICHEN_COAP_SERVER+LICHEN_SENML+LICHEN_LORA_L2, default n) and LICHEN_COAP_METRICS_LOG_LEVEL (int, dep LICHEN_COAP_METRICS, default 3, range 0 4) to coap/Kconfig. Previously CMakeLists.txt:61-62 gated coap_metrics.c on CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS and coap_metrics.c:17 used CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_METRICS_LOG_LEVEL, but neither symbol existed tree-wide -- module was unbuildable. Chose ADD over remove: coap_metrics.c is a substantive 123-line SenML /metrics resource, prerequisite for open P1 b7z9.29 (CCP-15 metrics layer). Deps match the file's includes (lichen/senml.h, lichen/l2/lora_l2.h) + server dep added this round (s8rl). default n keeps the mid-flight module off. Codereview NOTE: opencode run (kimi-k3 reviewer) hung twice at 300s timeout on this pass -- API issue; per worker step 4 fallback, performed the 3 passes (correctness/security/edge) myself and note it here. No findings: syntax valid, deps coherent with includes, LOG_LEVEL mirrors siblings, no other CMake refs to the symbol, default n appropriate.
